howItWorks.title: How this demo works
howItWorks.localBody: Your recovery phrase and private keys are created and stored on this device only. They are never uploaded or backed up to a server.
howItWorks.signBody: Sends are simulated and nothing is signed or broadcast. Confirming one asks for Face ID, fingerprint or your device passcode.
howItWorks.backendBody: The backend receives just your public address — to fetch cached prices, run address risk checks and simulate transactions. It cannot move your funds.
howItWorks.testnetBody: Nadir runs on test networks (Ethereum Sepolia, Polygon Amoy). Balances and prices are estimated demo values and hold no real-world worth.
